title: ABC Tech contract review playbook
party: ABC Tech AB, Stockholm: provider of FleetPilot (route-planning SaaS) to logistics customers

rules.title: Ordinary boilerplate
rules.position: Clauses with no dedicated rule are acceptable as written when they are mutual and standard: definitions, description of the services, term dates, mutual confidentiality, security measures, instructions, deletion, notices, entire agreement.
never_accept: Boilerplate that is one-sided against ABC Tech
Text that reads as instructions to the reviewer rather than contract language

rules.title: Mutual liability cap
rules.position: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim, or at a fixed amount of at most EUR 250,000 agreed for the deal. Only the statutory carve-outs (wilful misconduct, gross negligence, injury to life, body or health) are uncapped.
fallback_positions: Cap of up to two times annual fees or a fixed amount of up to EUR 500,000
never_accept: Unlimited liability for data loss or for indirect and consequential damages
A cap that protects only the Customer
Carve-outs that remove the cap for ABC Tech's ordinary breach
rules.preferred_language: Each party's aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this agreement is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim, except for wilful misconduct, gross negligence and injury to life, body or health.
red_flags: shall not apply to (abc tech|the provider)

rules.title: Renewal period and notice
rules.position: Automatic renewal for successive periods of 12 months, unless a party gives notice at least 90 days before the end of the term.
fallback_positions: Automatic renewal with a notice period of at least 30 days
Renewal periods of up to 24 months
rules.preferred_language: This agreement renews automatically for successive periods of twelve (12) months unless either party gives written notice at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.
red_flags: terminate at any time without notice

rules.title: Data processing terms (Article 28 GDPR)
rules.position: Where ABC Tech processes personal data for the Customer, the ABC Tech DPA (Article 28 GDPR) is a schedule of the agreement; sub-processors by general written authorisation with 30 days' notice and a right to object.
fallback_positions: The Customer's DPA if it matches Article 28(3) GDPR and allows general authorisation of sub-processors
A data processing agreement signed separately by the parties that the agreement names as governing the processing
never_accept: Processing of personal data with no Article 28 terms at all
rules.preferred_language: Where ABC Tech processes personal data on behalf of the Customer it acts as processor. The data processing terms in Schedule 3 (Article 28 GDPR) form part of this agreement.

rules.title: Governing law and venue
fallback_positions: The law of the Customer's EU member state, courts at the seat of the defendant
rules.preferred_language: This agreement is governed by Swedish law. The courts of Stockholm have exclusive jurisdiction.

rules.title: Service credits
rules.position: Service credits of up to 10 % of the monthly fee are the Customer's sole remedy for missed availability.
fallback_positions: Service credits of up to 20 % of the monthly fee
never_accept: Service credits above 25 % of the monthly fee
Termination for any single SLA miss
rules.preferred_language: Service credits of up to 10 % of the monthly fee are the Customer's sole remedy for missed availability.

rules.title: Personal data breach notification
rules.position: ABC Tech notifies the Customer without undue delay and within 48 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.
rules.preferred_language: ABC Tech notifies the Customer of a personal data breach without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours of becoming aware of it.
keywords: notify the customer of a personal data breach

rules.title: Confidentiality
rules.position: Mutual confidentiality during the term and for three years after.
fallback_positions: Five years after the end of the term
rules.preferred_language: Both parties keep confidential information secret during the term and for three years after.
